content.text: {"route":"review","reason":"The record gathered corroborating witness statements and the Agency accepted that E1 engaged in the conduct, so the facts appear reasonably developed. But the summary does not show what management knew or what corrective action it took. It does not show the CEO's or Deputy Director's accounts of the four reports, or why no incident report was provided. It also does not show E1's own response. The finding that management was not liable is stated without supporting detail. The summary is also silent on the disability basis evidence and on any comparators. Whether the legal conclusions are sound is a separate question, but a closer human look is needed to confirm that the full ROI covers management's response and E1's account."}
